Name: Shrouded by Mist
Description: Apply the following rules during the first game turn: • For Shooting Attacks made against units that are more than 12" away, all units are considered to be in Soft Cover. • Charge Range rolls made against friendly units that are more than 12" away are subject to Minimised Roll.

Name: Barbed Nets
Description: Afflict (-1 Str, -1 AP)

Name: Krakens Hide
Description: The wearer gains +1 Arm and <u><link="rulebook-strider">Strider (<u><link="rulebook-water_terrain">Water Terrain</link></u>)</link></u>.

Name: Worshipper Of Harag
Description: While in contact with a Water Terrain, if entierly with Height 0-1, the unit benefits from +1 Cha and Maximised Charge Range.

Name: Hurricane's Fury
Description:
Range 18", Shots 2D6. <u><link="rulebook-lightning_attacks">Lightning Attacks</link></u>.
If a unit is hit by one or more attacks from this weapon, all models in the unit suffer a -1 to-hit modifier (both for Shooting Attacks and Melee Attacks). Duration: One Turn.

Name: A Drop of Harag's Blood
Description: Duration: Permanent. Activation: Start of any Player Turn. All model parts with Elf in the bearer's unit gain Devastating Charge (+1 Str, +1 AP), Fearless, Unruly, and lose Light Troops. This does not give a unit with Light Troops Scoring.

Name: Chest of Enveloping Fog
Description: Duration: Permanent. One use only. Can be activated at the end of any friendly Movement Phase, if the bearer is Unengaged. Place a Water Terrain, in contact with the bearer and at least 1" away from enemy units and other Terrain Features. This Water Terrain has the dimensions of a 10"x6" rectangle.

Name: Veil of Harag
Description: The bearer can cast <u><link="rulebook-clouded_sight">Clouded Sight</link></u> (Witchcraft) as a <u><link="rulebook-bound_spells">Bound Spell</link></u> (6+).

Name: Storm Cloak
Description: The bearer gains <u><link="rulebook-hard_target">Hard Target (1)</link></u> and <u><link="rulebook-magic_resistance">Magic Resistance (2)</link></u>.

Name: Black Flag
Description: While in contact with the bearer's unit, enemy units Command Tests suffer from Maximised. In addition, friendly models in units Engaged in the same Combined Combat as the bearer's unit must re-roll 1's to wound.

Name: Banner of Tides
Description:
The bearer's unit gains <u><link="rulebook-feigned_flight">Feigned Flight</link></u> and <u><link="rulebook-hit_and_run">Hit and Run</link></u>.
In addition, when using <u><link="rulebook-hit_and_run">Hit and Run</link></u>, the unit automatically rallies at the end of 'Pursue Moves' (Round of Combat, 5.D). and cannot declare Charges in the following Player Turn.

Name: Tempest of the Storm Witch
Description: Target gains Lightning Attacks and +1 AP against Metal Armour.

Name: Obsidian Admiral
Description: The ‘Dread Captain’ model part’s Att is set to 5. At the beginning of ‘Roll-off for Attacker and Defender’ (Battle Preparations, 3.A), the army may gain a +1 to the roll-off. If doing so and winning the roll-off, the army must select be the Attacker.

Name: A Watery Grave
Description: Tethaen is always considered to have rolled a 3+ when rolling for whether he arrives using Ambush. In addition, at the beginning of 'Post Combat' (Round of Combat, 6), if Tethaen won the Round of Combat and an enemy Character in that Combat was removed as a casualty, then Tethaen may be placed in Ambush.

Name: Blessed by Harag
Description: Tethaen's rags and strange hat never stop dripping, even when out of the water. Aegis (5+), Resistance (against Flaming Attacks).

Name: Grim Harpoon
Description:
+1 Att, and counts as a <u><link="rulebook-great_weapon">Great Weapon</link></u> in Melee.
Any unit that suffers one or more ranged hits from this weapon loses <u><link="rulebook-swiftstride">Swiftstride</link></u>, and cannot regain it in any way. Duration: One Turn.

Name: Corsair Boarders
Description: The model gains +1 Arm, and replaces Light Armour with Metal Armour.

Name: Corsair Ravagers
Description: The model gains <u><link="rulebook-afflict">Afflict</link></u> (-1 <u><link="rulebook-discipline">Discipline</link></u>) and <u><link="rulebook-light_troops">Light Troops</link></u>.

Name: Captains Favored
Description: The unit gains <u><link="rulebook-devastating_charge">Devastating Charge (+1 Str, +1 AP)</link></u>, <u><link="rulebook-fearless">Fearless</link></u>, and <u><link="rulebook-unruly">Unruly</link></u>

Name: Forerunners
Description: The model gains <u><link="rulebook-light_troops">Light Troops</link></u>, <u><link="rulebook-scout">Scout</link></u>, and <u><link="rulebook-vanguard">Vanguard</link></u>.

Name: Omen of the Dread Fleet
Description: During Pre-game Selections, you may select a single Field, Forest, or Ruins Terrain Feature. That Terrain Feature is replaced with a Water Terrain rectangle of the dimensions 10"x6". All models consider all Water Terrain Features Dangerous Terrain (6+) instead of any other instance of Dangerous Terrain for all models. This rule applies even if the Avatar of Harag is in Ambush.

Name: Toxic Scum
Description: At Agility Step 10, all other units Engaged in the same Combat as the model suffer 1D6+1 hits with Toxic Attacks

Name: Advancing Gloom
Description: <u><link="de-under_the_cover_of_mists">Under the Cover of Mists</link></u> is extended until the end of the second Game Turn.

Name: Siren's Song
Description: Command Tests taken by enemy units within 8" of one or more models with this rule are Maximised. At the start of 'Combat Choices' (Round of Combat, 1.D), all enemy units in contact must take a Command Test. Each unit that fails it suffers -2 Def. Duration: Round of Combat.
